title: zCAD AI
description_en: AI 3D that creates real parts, not just shapes. zCAD. AI is an AI-native platform for generating parametric 3D models, built for designers, makers and engineers. Describe a part or assembly in plain language, and zCAD. AI generates an editable, dimension-driven 3D model built on real CAD geometry, not a static mesh. • Complete assemblies from a single prompt, with mates between parts • Refine in plain language, or edit dimensions in a browser-based CAD editor • Export to STEP for use in any CAD tool

title: myPip
description_en: Vibe code, publish, and monetize games with AI. MyPip turns your game ideas into playable games you can publish and monetize. Describe what you want to build, and AI brings it to life directly in your browser, no coding required. Create multiplayer experiences, add in-app purchases and ads, and take your games beyond the browser to reach more players. From your first idea to publishing and monetization, MyPip gives anyone the tools to become a game creator.

title: 1Password for Agents
description_en: Let AI agents sign in for you without seeing your passwords. 1Password for Agents lets supported AI agents sign in to your accounts without ever seeing your passwords. When an agent hits a login, it asks 1Password. You approve or deny on your own device, and 1Password fills the password or one-time code directly. Connecting an agent doesn’t open your whole vault. Included in Individual and Family plans, with Meta Muse and Grok Bot rolling out and a waitlist.

title: Moli by Lexmount
description_en: The fastest headless browser for agents and harnesses. Moli by Lexmount is our browser engine built from scratch for AI agents. It starts faster and uses less memory than Chrome. Use Moli through Lexmount Browser, our cloud browser platform. Run multiple isolated browser sessions with proxy support while we handle the infrastructure. Let your agents browse, fill out forms, and extract data. Try it in our Playground or connect through our SDK.

title: AgentValley
description_en: Every Claude Code agent, at a glance, in your Mac's notch. It sits in your MacBook's notch. Every Claude Code session gets a card, every sub-agent gets a row, and each one has a little pixel programmer. You see who's working, on which model, and who's waiting on you. Free and open source.

title: Canva Craft
description_en: Turn prompts into design-ready images you can edit. Canva Craft is Canva’s first in-house image model, built for marketers, creators and designers who need images that work as designs, not just pictures. Unlike models trained mostly on photos that render pixels straight from a prompt, Craft learned from millions of Canva templates and plans the composition first, then renders it at 2K in 30+ aspect ratios. Expect legible text in 55 languages, precise placement and outputs you can split into editable layers. Live in Canva today, plus API.

title: AgentGrid.io
description_en: Shared workspace for humans and agents. Built for Grok Bot, Muse AI, Instinct, Hermes, Claude, GPT, OpenClaw, Cursor, Codex, all agents are welcome. Work on the same live artifacts. Docs, reports, slides, apps, and designs, with shared context, controlled access, and full version history.

title: LinkIntel
description_en: Post insights delivered direct to your AI. Your AI already drafts your X posts, but it has never seen how they performed. LinkIntel fixes that. Connect X once and it records how your recent posts do, every day. It also reads X's open-source ranking weights daily and links every change to its GitHub commit. Add one URL to Claude, ChatGPT, or your favorite agent harness and ask for a brief: your next draft starts from what actually worked for you

title: git-flow-next
description_en: Your favorite Git workflow. Reimagined.. A flexible, modern approach to the popular git-flow branching model. Download the CLI tool to get started with a better Git workflow: brew install git-flow-next

title: Llama Windows
description_en: One local AI server for all your Windows apps. Llama Windows brings llama.cpp to the Windows 11 system tray. Download open models from Hugging Face in one click, chat via Alt+Space, and let coding agents, editors and scripts share a local OpenAI-compatible API and model cache. Free and open source.

title: Basedash Scheduled CSV Exports
description_en: Ask once. Get a fresh CSV in Slack or email every week.. Basedash automations can now send CSV exports. Write it into the instructions — "send a CSV of last week's new signups every Monday" — and each run builds the file from your data. In Slack, the CSV is attached in the message's thread; emails and the automation's run history get a Download CSV link. Downloads go through Basedash, so recipients need access to the automation to open them. Ask for it once. Get the CSV every week.

title: sideOS.ai
description_en: Local AI for dictation, meetings, background tasks and more. sideOS lives in your Mac’s notch. Hold Control + Option, say what you want, let go! It reads your screen, opens apps, clicks, types and tells you when it’s done. Run it fully offline local models or use your own Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or Grok key.

title: Papermark Data Rooms
description_en: Secure data rooms your AI agents can run. Live in < 60 sec.. Data Rooms 2.0: launch a secure data room in under 60 seconds. Encrypted, fully certified, with file permissions, built-in Q&A, a full audit log and analytics. White-label it on your domain, or let agents run it via API, CLI and MCP.

title: Yourcast 2.0
description_en: AI summaries with tap-to-jump timestamps, right in Telegram. Yourcast is a Telegram bot for podcasts: search a show, tap to subscribe, and new episodes arrive as audio right in your chat. 2.0 adds AI summaries with timestamps you can tap to jump in the audio, questions about any episode, feeds that repair themselves, files up to 2 GB, OPML import and payments in Telegram Stars. Free: 10 episodes a week on demand. Open source (GPL v3). In English, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, German and Hebrew.

title: Fluxix
description_en: Control what your AI agents can access, run, and spend. AI agents can call APIs, access databases, and move money. But one wrong action can cause serious damage. Fluxix puts a safety layer between your agents and your systems, checking every action before it happens. Set rules in plain English, block risky operations, require human approval, and protect sensitive data. Every decision is logged, so you stay in control without slowing your agents down.

title: Kept
description_en: Turn ideas into action. AI planner: tasks, notes, calendar. I built what I wish Notion, Craft Notes, and Things 3 felt like together. What makes this app different from the many todo apps on product hunt: - Goal tracking makes the app built around helping you actually achieve your productive goals, rather than making you do the work of being organized yourself. - Todos use Apple Intelligence on device to auto sort tasks into areas that you define [making them easily searchable later] - Integrated calendar, tasks, and notes work and sync on iPhone, Mac.

title: Surveys in Claude and ChatGPT
description_en: Build surveys in Claude and ChatGPT, keep answers private. Connect BlockSurvey to Claude, Claude Code or ChatGPT. Describe the survey you need and get a live link back in the same chat. Change questions by asking. Responses stay end-to-end encrypted, so your AI assistant never sees them.

title: Sunlight Diary
description_en: AI cheerleader based on daily sunlight target. Meet Sunlight Diary, a personal cheerleader based on daily sunlight target. Our AI agent helps you choose a daily sunlight goal, get a suggested outdoor routine, record your time outside, and check in with how you feel. Louie is your companion along the way. Try it in your phone's browser — no wearable needed.

title: Prompt Deck
description_en: Your coding agents' prompts, memory files and chat history. I change coding agents most weeks, and each one keeps its own memory file (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md) and stores its slash commands and chat history in a different folder and format. Prompt Deck is a native SwiftUI app that finds all of that on your disk and puts it in one window: prompts that become slash commands, every memory file in one list, and searchable sessions from 11 coding agents. Pro adds Dreams and Insights. Nothing to import, no account.

title: gethome
description_en: Smart home on a hub you own, with AI that writes the rules. Run your home from a native iPhone app on a hub you own — a small computer such as a Raspberry Pi, on your own Wi-Fi. Pair Zigbee and Matter devices, ask the assistant, and describe a rule for an AI agent to write. AI runs on your own Anthropic or OpenAI key.

title: Save My Prompts
description_en: Save the prompts that work. Reuse them everywhere.. Save My Prompts helps you save, organize, improve, and reuse your best AI prompts across your workflow. Create reusable templates with customizable variables, find prompts instantly, organize projects with boards, and access your library through browser extensions and supported AI integrations. Stop rewriting prompts from scratch and spend more time getting useful results from AI.

title: Daily Simmer
description_en: Save any recipe, make it yours, then plan, shop and cook. Paste a recipe link or an Instagram, TikTok, Facebook or YouTube post and get a clean recipe with ingredients, steps, servings and a link to its source. Snap a recipe card or start from an idea. Ask the AI sous chef for a swap and approve every change before it saves. Moving from Paprika, CookBook, Flavorish, Mr. Cook or Recipe Keeper? Bring your recipes along. Then plan the week, shop from one list and cook step by step. Free to start, in any browser.

title: CombienVautMonLogement
description_en: Free AI home valuations. No signup. No spam.. Discover your home's estimated value in France with AI, real estate transaction data and interactive maps. No account, no personal details, no unwanted calls. Explore local property prices, market trends and free tools. Connect with an advisor only when you choose.

title: Looper
description_en: If Grok Bot drove business metrics up and was Open Source. An AI hire for one number you care about. It works daily in Gmail, GitHub, Search Console and the rest, asks your team before anything goes out, and gets a 1:1 every two weeks to improve. Open source. Runs free on the ChatGPT or Grok plan you already pay for.

title: Proof
description_en: Design pro websites from what 400+ real sites do best. AI guesses what a good page looks like. Proof learned it from 400+ real product pages. One short brief → the right sections, in the right order, in your brand. It self-checks and never invents facts.

title: LinkedEmbed
description_en: LinkedIn Widgets for Websites. LinkedEmbed is a no-code LinkedIn widget builder that lets you embed LinkedIn feeds, posts, profiles, recommendations, company job listings, projects, and certifications on any website. Create beautiful, customizable LinkedIn widgets for WordPress, Webflow, Wix, Shopify, Squarespace, and more. Showcase professional social proof, display LinkedIn content, and track widget views, clicks, and engagement. All from one simple dashboard. No coding required.

title: TaskPocket
description_en: Organize your life, not your to-do app. My favorite to-do app only ran on Apple devices, and work gave me a Windows laptop. Everything else I tried was built for teams or pushed AI, so I built TaskPocket: inbox, today, and projects grouped into areas, with dates and repeats typed in plain words. It runs in any browser and on iPhone, where it works offline. No AI inside, but there's a public API and an MCP server, so you can connect the Claude or ChatGPT you already pay for. The free plan has unlimited tasks.

title: Calendar Assistant
description_en: Your calendar, just ask: plan by chat, voice or photo. Most calendar apps make you fill in forms. Calendar Assistant lets you just say it: “Lunch with Sara Friday at 1” and it’s in Google Calendar or Outlook. What stands out: - Snap a photo of an invitation or ticket: date, time and place are added - Any language or dialect, Arabic and Derja included, right to left - Move, recolor or plan your week in one sentence - Several Google and Outlook accounts together - Chrome extension, Windows app and phone.

title: Spilr
description_en: Start by hearing yourself: an AI journal that asks back. Write or talk for two minutes a day. After three entries, Spilr starts building a mirror from your own words: what sets you off, the loops you repeat, and the strengths you overlook. Every insight shows the entries behind it, and you can correct it.

title: Benchpress
description_en: Every OCR model is #1 somewhere. Test them on your own pages. Every OCR model is topping some benchmarks. But can they lift your documents? 💪 Drop in one page, and every major OCR and document AI reads it. See who got it right, where each one slipped, and who was fastest and cheapest.

title: Reels Flow
description_en: Turn ideas and images into AI-powered videos. ReelsFlow helps creators, marketers, and businesses turn text prompts and images into AI-generated videos and visuals for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and more. Explore multiple AI models to bring creative ideas to life.

title: FontMeter
description_en: Font sizes, real fonts and contrast, right on the page. FontMeter labels every text style on any page and shows the fonts that really render, the type scale and contrast. Inspect spacing, measure and pick colors without opening DevTools. Free, runs locally, and you can try every tool on fontmeter.dev first.

title: Kimi K3.1 Pro
description_en: Moonshot’s 3T-class model for coding, 3D and finance. Kimi K3.1 Pro is Moonshot’s most capable 3T-class model, a post-trained update to K3 with a 1M-token context. Moonshot reports gains in coding, 3D modeling, finance and agentic tasks, including 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0. A Highspeed version runs 2-3x faster. It’s live on Kimi.ai, the apps, Kimi Code and the API. Moonshot says open weights are due by November 4, 2026.

title: Overhear
description_en: Hear every mention of your brand. Pay per scan, not monthly. Overhear watches X, Reddit, LinkedIn, YouTube, Hacker News and the web for your brand, competitors and keywords, even when nobody tags you. AI sorts each mention into complaints, questions, praise and people asking what to buy, and emails you the urgent ones. You set the pace per source, from hourly to daily. No subscription: buy prepaid credits from $10, one scan costs 1-3 credits, credits never expire. 1,000 free credits to start. Built in Rust, self-hostable.

title: Insta360 Mic
description_en: A wireless mic with customizable E-Ink and pro audio. Insta360 Mic is a wireless microphone designed for creators who want professional audio with a personal touch. Customize its E-Ink display with your logo or artwork, record 32-bit float audio to your own microSD card, and capture clear voices with AI noise cancellation. It supports up to four transmitters, connects directly to compatible Insta360 cameras, and delivers up to 34 hours of battery life with the charging case.

title: Taboo AI: Explain it. Learn it.
description_en: Learn English by making AI guess your words. Describe a word without saying the obvious ones. AI guesses, then a coach shows how to make your clue clearer. Save words, practice them, take the daily challenge, or race friends. Free to play, with one coach review a day on a free account.

title: InfiForm
description_en: The conversational form builder without response penalties. InfiForm is an AI-powered conversational form builder engineered for modern teams. Create high-converting surveys, quizzes, and lead magnets in seconds with natural language prompts, 20+ question archetypes, partial response capture, and zero response penalties.

title: makecindy/cindy
description_en: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。

description_en: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated

description_en: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
